lieu: golden wedding anniversary party in a courtyard in Cocody, Abidjan, gold and white balloons, a banner without text, string lights, evening

persos.nom: the young TV journalist with the microphone
persos.desc: young TV journalist in her 20s, bright red blazer, short bob haircut, holding a microphone
persos.pose: standing on the left, holding the microphone toward the old man, smiling

persos.desc: proud old husband in his 70s, white hair, cream-and-gold embroidered grand boubou, a gold watch
persos.pose: standing in the middle facing the camera, proud

persos.desc: smiling old wife in her 70s, gold lace kaba with a matching gold gele, holding her husband's arm
persos.pose: standing on the right, holding her husband's arm, smiling proudly at the camera

dialogue: Tonton, cinquante ans de mariage ! C'est quoi votre secret dêh ?
J'aime la même femme depuis cinquante ans.
Ehh, c'est trop beau !
Si ma femme apprend ça, elle va me tuer dêh.
jeu: Nobody walks; all three stay in their places for the whole video. The old wife keeps smiling silently, holding his arm. The journalist asks with excitement. The old man answers proudly. The journalist is moved. The old man answers in a low confidential voice toward the microphone, his face clearly visible, forgetting his wife is holding his arm.
chute: The old wife's proud smile slowly freezes and she slowly turns her head toward her husband, still holding his arm. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the old wife's shocked face looking into the camera.

lieu: small courtyard of a house in Abobo, Abidjan, at dusk, the open wooden door of the house on the right showing a bedroom with a man lying on a mat inside, a plastic bucket, a clothesline

persos.desc: wife in her 30s, purple-and-green wax pagne wrapped as a dress, hair tied in a yellow scarf, hands on her hips
persos.pose: standing in front of the open door on the right, hands on her hips

persos.desc: neighbor in her 40s, long sky-white prayer robe, a white headscarf, both hands raised to the sky
persos.pose: standing in the middle of the courtyard facing the door, praying loudly with both hands raised

persos.nom: the husband lying on the mat
persos.desc: husband in his 40s, big belly, faded blue shorts, lying on his back on a mat inside the bedroom, sleeping
persos.pose: lying on the mat inside the room behind the open door, sleeping, he never moves

dialogue: Ma sœur, pourquoi tu pries fort comme ça devant ma porte-là ?!
On a dit de chasser les démons de la pauvreté dêh !
Ya fohi. Entre dans la chambre, il est couché.
jeu: Nobody walks; the two women stay in their places and the husband stays lying asleep on the mat behind the door for the whole video. The wife asks, annoyed. The neighbor answers with passion, hands still raised. The wife answers calmly, pointing with her thumb at the sleeping husband behind her, her face clearly visible.
chute: The neighbor slowly lowers her hands and stares at the sleeping husband on the mat. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the neighbor's shocked face looking into the camera.

lieu: living room of an apartment in Marcory, Abidjan, a grey sofa, a dining table, afternoon light

persos.nom: the panicked wife with the phone
persos.desc: wife in her 30s, sky-blue satin blouse, white jeans, long braids, holding her phone with both hands
persos.pose: standing in front of the sofa, panicked, showing her phone

persos.desc: husband in his 40s, thick beard, plum-purple kaftan shirt with gold buttons, holding a small bowl of peanuts
persos.pose: sitting on the sofa, calmly eating peanuts

dialogue: Chéri ! On a kidnappé ton petit frère ! Ils demandent deux millions dêh !
Ya fohi. Envoie-leur sa photo quand il mange. C'est eux qui vont nous payer pour le ramener.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The wife shouts in panic, showing her phone. The husband answers calmly, still eating peanuts, his face clearly visible.
chute: The wife freezes with the phone in her hands. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the wife's shocked face looking into the camera.

lieu: bedroom of an apartment in Riviera, Abidjan, a bed with a patterned bedspread, a bedside lamp, evening

persos.nom: the tender wife on the bed
persos.desc: wife in her 30s, rose-pink satin pyjamas, short curly hair, holding her husband's phone
persos.pose: sitting on the bed, holding the phone, smiling tenderly

persos.desc: husband in his 30s, thin glasses, plain navy pyjama top
persos.pose: standing next to the wardrobe, folding a towel

dialogue: Chéri, ton code Mobile Money-là, c'est notre date de mariage ?
Non. Le système a refusé dêh.
Pourquoi ?
Ils disent on met pas une erreur comme mot de passe.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The wife asks tenderly. The husband answers simply while folding his towel. The wife asks, curious. The husband answers calmly and sincerely, his face clearly visible.
chute: The wife's tender smile slowly freezes. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the wife's offended face looking into the camera.

source: classique mondial : le fou à contresens
lieu: inside an old car at night on a highway near Abidjan, seen from the dashboard, headlights of many cars coming straight toward them through the windshield

persos.nom: the worried wife in the passenger seat
persos.desc: wife in her 40s, orange-and-brown wax blouse, a matching head tie, holding a small radio
persos.pose: sitting in the passenger seat, holding the radio, worried

persos.desc: husband in his 40s, flat cap, checkered mint-and-brown shirt, both hands on the steering wheel
persos.pose: driving with both hands on the wheel, confident

dialogue: Chéri, la radio dit qu'un fou roule à contresens sur l'autoroute du Nord dêh !
Un seul ? Ma chérie, ils sont des centaines en face de moi !
jeu: Nobody moves from their seat; both stay seated for the whole video and the camera stays on the dashboard looking at them. Headlights keep coming toward the car through the windshield. The wife warns him, worried. The husband answers proudly, annoyed by the other cars, his face clearly visible.
chute: The wife slowly turns her head toward the headlights coming at them. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the wife's horrified face looking into the camera.

persos.nom: the shouting wife with the fitness bracelet
persos.desc: wife in her 30s, black sportswear with a fitness bracelet on her wrist, a high ponytail
persos.pose: standing, shouting and waving her arms

persos.nom: the smiling husband on the sofa
persos.desc: husband in his 30s, white headband, bright green tracksuit jacket, calm smile
persos.pose: sitting on the sofa, smiling calmly

dialogue: Chéri, pourquoi tu souris pendant que je crie-là ?!
Bébé, ton bracelet compte chaque geste comme un pas. Encore deux insultes, tu atteins ton objectif dêh.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The wife shouts, waving her arms. The husband answers calmly and kindly, pointing at her fitness bracelet, his face clearly visible.
chute: The wife freezes with her arms in the air and looks at her bracelet. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the wife's shocked face looking into the camera.

lieu: small living room in Koumassi, Abidjan, a wooden table with school books, a plastic chair, a wall clock, morning

persos.nom: the proud student with the letter
persos.desc: student around 18, pale-blue school uniform with a navy tie, holding an official letter
persos.pose: standing in front of his father, holding up the letter, very proud

persos.desc: father in his 50s, short white beard, faded brown polo shirt, sitting at the table

dialogue: Papa, j'ai eu la bourse dêh !
Ehh ! C'est combien, mon fils ?
Cinquante mille chaque mois !
Ya fohi. À partir d'aujourd'hui, c'est toi le père. Moi, je vais réviser.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The student announces it proudly. The father asks, very interested. The student answers proudly. The father answers seriously, pushing the school books toward himself, his face clearly visible.
chute: The student's proud smile slowly freezes. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the student's shocked face looking into the camera.
